title.narrative: Multi Donor Trust Fund for the Strengthening Public Expenditure Management Program (SPEMP)

description.narrative:
"The MDTF supports an umbrella PFM program built around three key priority areas: i) budget planningcomma preparation and executioncomma (ii) external auditingcomma and iii) legislative and public oversight. The MDTF can finance several projects that fall within these three key areas in a sequenced and prioritized manner. The first objective of the MDTF is to strengthen and modernize core institutions for budget management within the government with particular emphasis on introducing a performance orientation in PFM. The TF aids the Government of Bangladesh in implementing their ""Public Financial Management Reform Strategy - Vision and Medium-Term Rolling Action Plancomma 2007-2012"". This TF will help to strengthen the strategic focus of budgeting and establish a comprehensive accounting and treasury management system.
The second objective is to enhance the demand side interventions for better budget outcomes by improving the effectiveness of formal institutions of financial accountability through strengthening the capacity of the Comptroller & Auditor General (C&AG) for higher quality auditscomma and strengthening legislative oversight through a better functioning of the parliamentary committees that deal with allocation and monitoring of government resources."
